comment: Which upstream compiler crates are ported. Changing this file needs the owner's approval (see AGENTS.md).

excluded.rustc_public: stable MIR API for external tools
excluded.rustc_public_bridge: stable MIR API for external tools
excluded.rustc_incremental: incremental compilation is out of scope
excluded.rustc_thread_pool: parallel frontend is out of scope

crates.comment: Compiler crates with per-path scope, like `miri` (lane scope-m7, plan-m7 D4): paths relative to compiler/<crate>. `excluded`: files, or directories with everything under them, out of coverage (unported paths stop with unported(...)). `partial`: files of which only the listed fns are in scope. Markers on excluded paths are still checked against upstream; they count for nothing.

excluded.src/llvm/ffi.rs: the seam (plan-m7 D4): its extern fns are the IR model's (src/rust_ts/llvm/, D5), not ported fns; owner decision 2026-11-11
excluded.src/typetree.rs: Enzyme type trees, -Zautodiff (plan-m7 D18); owner decision 2026-11-11

miri.comment: Miri, ported like a compiler crate (plan-m6 D2): src/tools/miri/src/<path>.rs -> src/miri/<path>.ts, markers `// rustc: src/tools/miri/src/<path>:<line> <name>`, coverage crate `miri`. `excluded`: paths (files, or directories with everything under them) out of M6's scope, which stop with unported(...). `partial`: files of which only the listed fns are in scope.

excluded.shims/windows: Windows shims; the target is x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu (plan-m6 D2)
excluded.shims/unix/socket_address.rs: sockets beyond the isolation error (plan-m6 D2, A3)
excluded.shims/unix/tcp_socket.rs: sockets beyond the isolation error (plan-m6 D2, A3)
excluded.bin/log/tracing_chrome.rs: Chrome trace output of MIRI_TRACING (plan-m6 D2)

shims/unix/socket.rs.reason: plan-m6 A3: only the isolation-error path that run-pass cases reach (`socket`, socket.rs:172 `reject_in_isolation`); with isolation on no socket fd exists, so the other socket shims are unreachable

tools.comment: M8's tools, ported like Miri (plan-m8 D1, D4; lane tools-prep-m8): each `crates` entry is a coverage crate over `root` (upstream-relative), with `excluded` and `partial` relative to it as Miri's. src/tools/clippy/<crate>/src/<path>.rs -> src/<crate>/<path>.ts; src/tools/clippy/src/<path>.rs -> src/clippy/<path>.ts; src/tools/rustfmt/src/<path>.rs -> src/rustfmt/<path>.ts. Markers `// rustc: src/tools/<tool>/.../<path>.rs:<line> <name>`. `excluded`: the tools' upstream trees that are out of M8, with reasons; a `// rustc:` marker under src/tools/ outside every root (and Miri's) is an ERROR of `coverage.ts --check`. declare_clippy_lint and rustc_tools_util are counted (plan-m8 §1c's in-scope total, D14's clippy-contract-a) though D4 does not name them; their macros come from tools/codegen (D5).

excluded.src/tools/clippy/clippy_dev: clippy's developer tool, not in the clippy-preview component (plan-m8 D4)
excluded.src/tools/clippy/lintcheck: clippy's lint-checking tool for crates.io crates, not in the component (plan-m8 D4)
excluded.src/tools/clippy/clippy_lints_internal: clippy's internal lints, built only with feature `internal`, not in the component (plan-m8 §1c, D4)
excluded.src/tools/clippy/clippy_dummy: a placeholder crate, not in the component (plan-m8 D4)
excluded.src/tools/clippy/clippy_test_deps: the ui tests' dependencies, built by the oracle's cargo (plan-m8 D10)
excluded.src/tools/rustfmt/check_diff: rustfmt's CI tool comparing two rustfmt builds, not in the rustfmt-preview component (plan-m8 D4)
excluded.src/tools/rustfmt/ci: rustfmt's CI helper, not in the component
excluded.src/tools/rustfmt/config_proc_macro: proc macros; replaced by tools/codegen (plan-m8 D5)
